selectedTransport: bounded automatic authenticated WindowWatch request; no user Refresh
rejectedBroaderOption: Unsolicited push requires new ingress-idle scheduling and admission. PersistentOwnerWake retires the gate and is not a change notification. Original UI011 does not require unsolicited push.

capability.semantics: Only the actual configured same-binding lexical live owner may advertise watch after existing admission read. Legacy constructor and read-only attachment retain their exact wire. No watch inferred from read, generation, JSON config or appId. Exact ordering/duplicates/unknown entries rejected.

requestRules: Exactly five fields; nonzero decimal-string counters, strict full Binding.
Same actual authenticated Scope/PeerCredential and original AdmissionDeadline as WindowRead.
One outstanding watch in frontend; monotonic shared backend request high-water mark reserved BEFORE owner IO.
observedRevision must equal last published snapshot revision held by this Reader; stale base returns Unavailable without owner IO.
replyRules: Exactly seven fields. Unchanged/Unknown/Unavailable require null snapshot. Changed requires strict owner-bound WindowSnapshot with revision greater than observedRevision.

Unchanged is emitted only after actual current readToplevelSnapshot returns a committed snapshot equal to the cached FT.Snapshot by opaque Handle/Output generations and full committed title/appId/state/output/parent content. No reply-counter inference.

Changed publishes the actually read snapshot through existing nonreused handle/output ordinal mapping and increments published revision once. Harmless metadata/other-window changes are Changed facts but are NOT opener closure.
Unknown consumes the request, stops watching and retains existing uncertainty/fault semantics. No replay, fallback grant or autonomous mutation.
Unchanged does not advance published revision, menu stamp, lease, menu ID or GUI publication.

backendSeam.sameThread: Backend.runBackend encloses runBackendWithObservation inside withForeignToplevelOwner; existing Aggregate receive/credential dispatch stays unchanged.
backendSeam.Reader: Extend only Reader/Ledger with Maybe FT.Snapshot for last successfully published state. Existing readWindowReply stores that snapshot with its actual revision.
backendSeam.newFunction: readWindowWatchReply :: Reader -> Scope -> PeerCredential -> DesktopRequest -> IO DesktopReply
backendSeam.admission: Same withCurrentAdmission/validateReaderScope path. Shared monotonic request reservation. Existing owner read/checks; no new worker, reconnect, timer, idle admission or fresh duration.
backendSeam.capabilityConstructor: applicationAttachedWithWindowWatch :: Binding -> ApplicationAvailability -> Either Text DesktopReply; existing applicationAttachedWithWindowObservation unchanged.

frontendSeam.timer: Desktop.ArmWindowWatch opaque token -> existing DesktopPolicy.Delay 100ms -> Desktop.WindowWatchDue token. This delay is backpressure, not authorization/deadline.
frontendSeam.token: Captured full binding, owner generation, presentation owner, MenuId, current menu binding/fingerprint and published observation revision; token invalidated by close, supersession, stop or a newer arm.
frontendSeam.pending: Dedicated windowWatchExpected request/base-revision; ordinary windowExpected remains separate so in-flight watch never disables the current menu or fakes closure.
frontendSeam.currentReply: Only exact expected request/base revision/binding/owner and still-current keyboard scope can settle. Closed/replaced presentation ignores old result and never resurrects scope.
frontendSeam.unchanged: Clear watch pending, schedule one successor token, emit no Focus and no GUI Publish; existing menu and stamp remain identical.
frontendSeam.changedEligibleOrigin: Only the correlated watch-result branch may update actual observation and use existing Menu.rebindReady through MenuBridge, retaining MenuId/items/lease/focus when captured full fingerprint remains eligible. Refresh captured observed rows/stamp/menu binding/menuOrigin consistently. Harmless same-origin metadata and unrelated-window changes do not dismiss or restore. Ordinary explicit Refresh behavior remains unchanged.
frontendSeam.changedClosedOrigin: Only a successful current Changed snapshot proving the captured full group fingerprint absent/replaced/ineligible closes this keyboard scope. Create one distinct current Applications fallback intent under same binding/presentation and exact enabled identity. Do not deliver old-origin focus to the replacement, or call any Changed snapshot closure.
frontendSeam.counterOnlyChanged: Reject semantically unchanged Changed payload (apart from revision). Do not retire or focus. Backend never emits it.
frontendSeam.transport: OutputController observation bookkeeping must classify window-watch so omitted/unsent/refused batches cancel it without replay. SurfaceController must not publish solely because private watch bookkeeping changed; compare actual same-scope rendered packet. DesktopPolicy timer-only watch effect must not manufacture an empty commit. Existing non-watch publication behavior remains unchanged.
